response.overview: The Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2016 is a television special that showcases the world's leading lingerie brand's annual runway event, filmed at the Grand Palais in Paris, France. It blends high-fashion lingerie modeling, elaborate costume design, and live musical entertainment into a highly stylized pop-culture broadcast.
response.tagline: THE ANGELS ARE LANDING IN PARIS.
response.title: The Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2016
